text: The Patriots are getting healthier ahead of Sunday's 1 PM ET matchup against the Jets, with A.J. Brown activated from injured reserve after missing four games with a right high ankle sprain, while Will Campbell and TreVeyon Henderson also return to the lineup—though the good news on the receiving end came with a scare when Romeo Doubs was injured after hauling in a 42-yard touchdown pass from Drake Maye in the first quarter of last week's game. The team elevated safety Elliott Davison from the practice squad and will field two rookies in starting roles as part of what appears to be their most talented roster through five weeks, though they'll face a Jets team led by Geno Smith, who's riding a notable streak without throwing an interception into this divisional showdown.
